verses.text: A wise woman builds up her household. A foolish one tears hers down with her own hands.
People who live upright show reverence for the LORD. People who live crooked show contempt for him.
Foolish talk earns a rod across the back. Wise words can keep you safe.
Without oxen, the feeding trough stays clean. With the strength of an ox, you can bring in a big harvest.
An honest witness won't lie. A false witness pours out lies.
A mocker goes looking for wisdom and comes up empty. Knowledge comes easily to someone with good judgment.
Keep your distance from a fool. You won't hear anything worth learning from their lips.
A sensible person's wisdom shows in how carefully they think through their next move. Fools get tangled up in deceit.
Fools laugh at the idea of making amends for sin. Among people who live honestly, there's goodwill.
Your heart knows its own bitterness, and a stranger can't share in its joy.
The house of the wicked will come crashing down. The tent of honest people will thrive.
Some roads look right when you start out, but follow them to the end and they take you straight to death.
You can laugh while your heart is hurting, and having a good time can end in grief.
People who break trust will get back what their choices earned them. A good person will also get the reward their actions deserve.
Someone gullible believes every word. Someone sensible stops and thinks about where they're going.
A wise person sees the danger in evil and stays clear. A fool gets heated and rushes in without thinking.
Lose your temper fast and you'll do something foolish. People hate someone who's always scheming.
Gullible people inherit foolishness. People with good judgment wear knowledge like a crown.
People who do evil will bow before those who do good. The wicked will bow at the gates of those who do right.
A poor person gets brushed off even by their own neighbor. A rich person has friends everywhere.
Looking down on your neighbor is a sin. Showing kindness to poor people brings a blessing.
People who plot evil lose their way. Love and faithfulness belong to people who plan good things.
Hard work pays off. All talk gets you nothing but poverty.
Money is a crown for wise people. What crowns a fool is more foolishness.
A witness who tells the truth saves lives. A false witness deals in lies.
Standing in awe of the LORD gives you a fortress you can count on, and he'll be a refuge for his children.
Standing in awe of the LORD is a fountain that gives life and turns people away from death's traps.
A king's glory is in having many people to rule. Without people, a ruler is ruined.
It takes real understanding to stay slow to anger. A quick temper puts foolishness on display.
A heart at peace gives life to the body. Envy eats away at your bones.
Push poor people around and you insult the one who made you. Show kindness to people in need and you honor him.
Disaster brings the wicked down. People who do right have a refuge even in death.
Wisdom settles in the heart of someone who understands. It even makes itself known inside fools.
Doing right lifts a nation up. Sin brings disgrace to any people.
A king favors a servant who handles things wisely. He's furious with a servant who brings him shame.
